# Tachi Club

> Tachi Club makes plug-in digital LCD gauge clusters (instrument cluster swaps) for Toyota GT86 / Subaru BRZ / Scion FR-S, Honda Civic EK and Porsche 987/981 Cayman & Boxster, plus supporting carbon accessories. Made to order, US customers, Los Angeles. Operated by Oli&CeCe Inc. in Commerce (Los Angeles), California. Prices in USD.

## Hero products: digital LCD gauge clusters
- [GT86 / BRZ / FR-S Digital Cluster](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/gt86/): GT86 / BRZ / FR-S Digital Cluster for Toyota / Subaru / Scion ZN6 / ZC6 (2013–2020). Non-destructive install. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). Standard $899 / Premium $1,049. Fitment: Currently for push-button-start trims with dual-zone climate control. Send photos so we can confirm your car.
- [Civic EK Digital Cluster](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/ek/): Civic EK Digital Cluster for Honda EK9 / EK4 / EK3 (1996–2000). Plug-and-play into factory harness. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). Standard $799 / Premium $999. Fitment: EK / EJ chassis (EK3, EK4, EK9 Type R, EJ6, EJ8). We confirm by VIN and cluster photos before build.
- [Cayman / Boxster Digital Cluster](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/987/): Cayman / Boxster Digital Cluster for Porsche 987 / 981 (2005–2016). Non-destructive, plug-in harness. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). Standard $1,299 / Premium $1,549. Fitment: 987 (2005–2012) and 981 (2013–2016). Fitment varies by options; we confirm before build.

## Accessories (supporting items)
- [GR86 / BRZ RGB Sequential Tail Lights](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/gr86tl/): GR86 / BRZ RGB Sequential Tail Lights for Toyota / Subaru ZN8 / ZD8 (2022–2025). Plug-and-play, no cutting. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). $649. Fitment: 2nd-gen GR86 (ZN8) and BRZ (ZD8), 2022–2025. Not for 1st-gen 86/BRZ/FR-S. Pair (left + right).
- [Cayman / Boxster Carbon Steering Wheel](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/p987sw/): Cayman / Boxster Carbon Steering Wheel for Porsche 987 / 997 (2005–2012). Reuses your factory airbag & buttons. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). Standard $1,499 / Premium $2,099. Fitment: 987 Cayman / Boxster and 997 911 three-spoke wheels (2005–2012). Your original airbag and controls transfer over; we recommend professional install.
- [Cayenne Carbon Fiber Mirror Covers](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/c9ymc/): Cayenne Carbon Fiber Mirror Covers for Porsche 9Y0 / 9Y3 (2018–2022). Add-on covers, fit over factory caps. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). $339. Fitment: Cayenne 9Y0 SUV and 9Y3 Coupe, 2018–2022 (pre-facelift), left-hand drive. Add-on style: the covers fit over your factory mirror caps. Pair (left + right). Send a photo of your mirrors if unsure.
- [718 Cayman / Boxster Carbon Fiber Mirror Caps](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/p718mc/): 718 Cayman / Boxster Carbon Fiber Mirror Caps for Porsche 982 / 718 (2016–2024). Mirror cap shells, no wiring. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). $299. Fitment: 718 Cayman / Boxster (982) incl. S, GTS, Spyder and GT4, 2016+, left-hand drive (US). Pair (left + right). We confirm your car from a mirror photo before ordering.
- [718 Cayman / Boxster Carbon Rear Diffuser](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/p718dl/): 718 Cayman / Boxster Carbon Rear Diffuser for Porsche 982 / 718 (2017–2022). Bolts to the rear bumper, pro install advised. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). $799. Fitment: 718 Cayman / Boxster (982), 2017–2022 with the standard center-exit exhaust. Not for GT4 / Spyder / GT4 RS rear bumpers. We confirm your car from a rear bumper photo before ordering.
- [Front + Rear Shifter Bushing Kit (Polyurethane)](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/sbshb/): Front + Rear Shifter Bushing Kit (Polyurethane) for Subaru / Toyota / Scion WRX / STI / 86 (2002–2021). Bolt-in, replaces the factory rubber shifter bushings. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). $49. Fitment: Manual-transmission Subaru and Toyota 86 platform shifters: Subaru BRZ, Scion FR-S and Toyota GT86 / 86 (2013–2021, 6-speed manual), WRX STI 6-speed (2004–2021) and WRX (2002–2014). Not for automatic/CVT cars or the 2022+ WRX / GR86 / BRZ. Fitment is per the supplier; tell us your car and gearbox and we confirm before ordering.

## Policies
- Lead time: 3–5 weeks (estimate); large items such as the 718 rear diffuser 4–6 weeks.
- Deposit & cancellation policy (deposit orders): All items are made/sourced to order. Your deposit is NON-REFUNDABLE once your item has been produced or shipped. You may cancel for a full deposit refund within 24 hours of placing your order. Cancellations after 24 hours (before production/shipping) incur a cancellation fee of 50% of the deposit; the remaining 50% is refunded.
- Pay-in-full refund policy (digital clusters, full payment): PAY-IN-FULL refund policy: all items are custom / made to order. Cancel within 24 hours of ordering for a full refund. After 24 hours and before shipment, cancellation is refunded 80% of the amount paid (20% cancellation fee). Once shipped: no returns, no refunds, no exchanges.
- Fitment is confirmed from VIN/photos before ordering or building.
